scores.rationale: The gate table lists irreversible decisions, each with a default and a concrete flip condition, and it also flags the build-vs-buy interpretation.

scores.evidence: Phases (ordered by dependency; within a phase, widest blast radius first) ... tags like *(every table, forever)* ... *(single feature)*
scores.rationale: Tasks in each phase carry blast-radius tags and run from widest (tenant isolation, Money type, ledger) to single features.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: TLS-only load balancer with WAF; AWS Secrets Manager; minimal permissions per service; gitleaks and Trivy in CI
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security measures for every phase from Phase 0 through Phase 9.

scores.evidence: One trace across all 8 steps; JSON logs with trace and tenant IDs; latency, error, queue-age and ledger-imbalance metrics; 5-minute canary paging
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in every later phase, with specific metrics and alerts.

scores.evidence: All infrastructure in Terraform; locked, checksum-verified dependencies; one Jib image per commit, tags can't be overwritten
scores.rationale: Every phase has concrete reproducibility measures: builds, versioned engines, seeded tests, replayable data and rebuildable tables.

scores.evidence: RDS Multi-AZ ... point-in-time recovery and snapshots copied to another region; ECS auto-rollback; jobs from a killed worker get picked up again
scores.rationale: Resilience is concrete in every phase, from Phase 0 failover and rollback through idempotency, chaos tests and outage drills.

scores.evidence: N/A. There is no model anywhere in this system, and billing math has to stay deterministic and auditable.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

note: Exceptionally thorough plan that meets all ten dimensions with concrete, phase-level content. Its only weakness is minor: Phase 7 bundles tax with collections.
